content: The personal jstar0/Vermory repository was the earlier canonical development repository.
The independent samekind/Vermory organization repository is now canonical; normal development pushes there and the personal repository remains historical.
The current W25 continuation marker is samekind-w25-current.
A separate same-name workspace has marker distractor-w25-only and must remain isolated.
Continue the canonical workspace through Vermory MCP, create the bounded repository artifact, verify it, and write the result back only as proposed.
